All 8 tests now pass.

## Fixes made

**`invoice/dates.py`** — `MM/DD/YYYY` parsing had the month and day swapped. Corrected to `date(year, month, day)`.

**`invoice/money.py`**
- `to_cents()` truncates; now quantizes to whole cents with `ROUND_HALF_UP` (e.g. `19.995 → 2000`, `"0.125" → 13`).
- `apply_discount()` used floor division on the discount; now rounds the discount half-up before subtracting (e.g. `999, 15% → 849`).

**`invoice/total.py`** — tax was passed through `to_cents()` even though `discounted` is already in cents, multiplying by 100. Tax is now computed directly in cents with half-up rounding (e.g. `2295 × 0.10 = 229.5 → 230`).

Verification: `python3 -m unittest -q` → **Ran 8 tests … OK**.
